sequence.observation: Bodega Wine Bar is selected and its compact place card is entering above the map chrome.
The compact place card is fully visible and ready for a single tap.
After the attempted card interaction and the app-driven recenter, the card is gone and the selected pin remains active, but no place profile is visible.

observed: The compact place card disappears as the app-driven pin recenter completes, so the attempted card interaction does not present the place profile. The failure repeats for multiple places.
root_cause: The camera tracker classified the programmatic pin-selection recenter as a one-finger user pan and dismissed the compact selection when MapKit reported the camera animation complete.
expected: The first compact place-card tap immediately presents the selected place's full profile while preserving the selected pin context.
